title: New patient, cleaning, confirms the caller-ID number
script: Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning, I'm a new patient.

p.phone: Yes, the number I'm calling from.

title: Existing patient reschedules
script: Hi, I have an appointment Thursday at 10 and I need to move it.

p.new: I've been coming there for years.
p.phone: Yes, the number I'm calling from.

title: Caller gives a different call-back number
script: Hi, my tooth hurts, can someone call me back?

title: Caller refuses to leave a number
script: What are your hours on Saturday?

title: Spanish speaker, new patient
script: Hola, quiero hacer una cita para una limpieza.

p.phone: Sí, el número desde el que llamo.
